params.body:
Saturday morning is by appointment, and an opening-hours line had no place to say so.

## What changes

- `openingHoursEntry` gets **`note`** (title *Extra tekst*, localeString, optional): text shown with the hours on the site, for example "op afspraak". Left empty, nothing is shown.
- The list preview shows it after the times: "07:30 tot 12:00 (op afspraak)".
- `CONTRACT.md` and `tests/contract.test.ts` follow.

The site side is ShaneDeconinck/schoutteet, branch `workbench/saturday-appointment`.

## After merge

Deploy the Studio, then add under *Instellingen en openingsuren* > *Openingsuren*: Zaterdag, Saturday, 07:30 to 12:00, *Extra tekst* "op afspraak" (en "by appointment", fr "sur rendez-vous", de "nach Vereinbarung", es "con cita previa"), and publish.

## Checks

- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean
- `npx vitest run`: 13 passed
- `npx eslint schemaTypes tests`: clean
